setup_structure_body: Add a grade, then its classes. Every student belongs to one home class; blocking plans and login codes are per class.
setup_zones_body: Draw the area where phones are blocked. A student outside it is never blocked, so cover the whole campus.
setup_students_body: Upload the student list from a spreadsheet (name, ID number, class) or add students one by one from a class page.
setup_teachers_body: Teachers open the live view of their classes and can pause blocking for a lesson. You can add them later.
setup_plans_body: Open a class, then Settings, and add a plan - from a template (08:00 to 13:00, 14:00 or 15:00) or your own windows. Only an active plan blocks.
